description:
I’m saksham, an engineering admission and career counsellor who supports students in making clear and practical choices.
I guide students through college and branch selection across Maharashtra, keeping ranks, cutoffs, and career goals in focus.
My work includes CAP round guidance, cutoff analysis, and careful option filling.
I focus on honest communication, simple explanations, and realistic advice.
My aim is to make the admission journey smooth and stress-free for students and families.
